_comment: Copy to config.local.json (gitignored) and fill in. Delivery (recipient + Photon) is required for alerts; `llm` is only needed for the two-way agent.
_delivery: spectrum-ts cloud when projectId+projectSecret are set (Photon is free for 1 user); omit them (or set forceLocal:true) for local mode.
projectSecret: <photon project secret — keep out of git>
_llm: Bring-your-own key for the two-way agent. Replace `llm` with ONE of these provider blocks:

_llm_claude_cli._note: uses your local `claude` login; no key needed

_card: OPTIONAL (cloud only): render disk alerts as an iMessage mini-app card (rich bubble + lock-screen summary + tap-to-open URL) instead of plain text. Needs a real iMessage extension's identifiers; without one, recipients see the summary + app name and the tap may no-op. Falls back to text automatically. Remove this block to keep plain-text alerts.
